My request:
Show what each country's authors earned last quarter, top country first.

content.text: What date should “last quarter” be relative to, and do you mean earnings as total sales revenue (quantity × unit_price)?

input.content: Use April through June 2024, and yes, earnings means total sales revenue.

content.text:
```sqlite
SELECT
    a.country,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price), 0.0) AS total_revenue
FROM authors AS a
LEFT JOIN books AS b
    ON b.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN sales AS s
    ON s.book_id = b.book_id
   AND s.sale_date >= '2024-04-01'
   AND s.sale_date < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY a.country
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, a.country ASC;
```

input.content: That's right, thank you. Here is my next question: Which of the top country's books sold that quarter? Show each title with its revenue.

content.text:
```sqlite
WITH country_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        a.country,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price), 0.0) AS total_revenue
    FROM authors AS a
    LEFT JOIN books AS b
        ON b.author_id = a.author_id
    LEFT JOIN sales AS s
        ON s.book_id = b.book_id
       AND s.sale_date >= '2024-04-01'
       AND s.sale_date < '2024-07-01'
    GROUP BY a.country
),
top_country AS (
    SELECT country
    FROM country_revenue
    ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, country ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    b.title,
    SUM(s.quantity * s.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM top_country AS tc
JOIN authors AS a
    ON a.country IS tc.country
JOIN books AS b
    ON b.author_id = a.author_id
JOIN sales AS s
    ON s.book_id = b.book_id
WHERE s.sale_date >= '2024-04-01'
  AND s.sale_date < '2024-07-01'
GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title
ORDER BY revenue DESC, b.title ASC;
```
